tool_input.description: Read discussions query and comment mutations

result:
Each row of the discussions list now shows how many comments the discussion has and when the last one was written. If there are no comments, the row says "No comments yet". As you asked, I did not run tests, lint or the app, so none of this is verified.

- **Types** (`src/types/api.ts`): `Discussion` has two new fields, `commentsCount: number` and `lastCommentAt: number | null`. This file has a comment saying to imagine it is generated from the backend. I edited it anyway because the project rules say API types are declared only there. A real backend would need to send these two fields.
- **Mock API** (`src/testing/mocks/handlers/discussions.ts`): a new helper, `getCommentStats`, counts a discussion's comments and finds the newest comment date. Both `GET /discussions` and `GET /discussions/:discussionId` now return these values, so a discussion looks the same from either endpoint.
- **List** (`src/features/discussions/components/discussions-list.tsx`): there are two new columns, "Comments" with the count and "Last Comment". "Last Comment" shows the date through `formatDate`, or "No comments yet".
- **Test** (`src/app/routes/app/discussions/__tests__/discussions.test.tsx`): the expected row text now includes `0 No comments yet`, because the test finds the row by its full text.

One limit: after someone adds or deletes a comment, the list can show old numbers until its cached data is refreshed. The comment mutations are in the `comments` feature. The project rules do not let one feature import from another, so those mutations cannot tell the discussions list to refresh. If you want the numbers to update at once, the way to do it is to pass an `onSuccess` from `src/app` (where features are combined) that refreshes the discussions list.
